description: Backend: fix shared-IP rate-limit bucket (trustProxy), guarantee Retry-After + RATE_LIMITED logging, add recommendation cache with in-flight dedupe and distinct error codes, and make live-room storage visible and fail-fast in production. Independent of frontend; must land first.
steps: env.ts: add TRUST_PROXY_HOPS (default 1 in production else 0) and ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE; throw in readEnvironment when NODE_ENV=production and STORAGE is file/memory without the escape hatch.

app.ts:44 pass trustProxy hops (thread via buildApp options, server.ts passes env value); app.ts error handler: set retry-after header and retryAfterSeconds in body for 429, log RATE_LIMITED warn (route, no tokens); add errorResponseBuilder if needed.

room.routes.ts:102 recommendation route: per-route rate limit (60/min), per room+team cache keyed by sequence+active playerId with shared in-flight promise and bounded map; RECOMMENDATION_UNAVAILABLE (409) when no active player; ROOM_NOT_FOUND stays from loadRoom. Read recommendation.service.ts first.
server.ts: log '[auction] storage=<kind>' for postgres/file/memory; error log when ephemeral escape hatch used.

Tests: backend/tests/recommendation-rate-limit.test.ts (Retry-After, per-client keys via X-Forwarded-For, cache dedupe, error codes, missing room 404, required room-state fields) and env test (production default postgres, production+file throws). Extend restart simulation using restart-recovery.test.ts pattern.
acceptance_criteria: 429 responses include Retry-After header and RATE_LIMITED body
N concurrent recommendation requests invoke recommend once
production with STORAGE unset resolves to postgres; production with STORAGE=file/memory throws unless ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE=true
distinct clients behind one proxy get separate limiter buckets
verification: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/recommendation-rate-limit.test.ts
cd backend; npx vitest run (only known baseline failures allowed)
findings: Done. env.ts: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS (default 1 in production, else 0), ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE; production + STORAGE file/memory throws unless ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE=true. app.ts: trustProxy function trusting N hops (not trustProxy:true); errorResponseBuilder; 429 handler sets Retry-After header, body error.retryAfterSeconds, logs RATE_LIMITED warn (route, method only). room.routes.ts: recommendation route limit 60/min, per room+team cache keyed by sequence+active playerId with shared in-flight promise (bounded 500, failures evicted). Existing typed 409 NO_ACTIVE_PLAYER kept (no new RECOMMENDATION_UNAVAILABLE code; service already throws typed error); ROOM_NOT_FOUND 404 only from loadRoom. server.ts: logs '[auction] storage=<kind> nodeEnv=..' for file/memory plus ephemeral WARNING in production. Frontend must treat 409 NO_ACTIVE_PLAYER as unavailable/no-retry. Render env: NODE_ENV=production; STORAGE=postgres or unset (never file/memory); DATABASE_URL=Supabase Postgres string; SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY set; TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=1 (default in production); optional ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE only to knowingly accept room loss. Apply migration 20261003090000_live_room_snapshots.sql; check logs for '[auction] storage=postgres'. Tests: tsc --noEmit exit 0; tests/recommendation-rate-limit.test.ts 9/9 pass; full vitest 331 pass, 7 fail = known baseline (5 skip-vote.test + 1 integration skip-vote + 1 manager-mode timeout). No room-state field gaps found; room DGQYCD is unrecoverable (0 DB rows).
